The InSinkErator Standard 460 food waste disposer is a compact and efficient kitchen appliance designed for convenient food waste removal. Featuring a powerful 0.55 horsepower induction motor and Single-Stage Grind Technology, it effectively processes daily food scraps. The space-saving design makes it an ideal choice for smaller kitchens or home improvement projects, and installation is straightforward with Lift and Latch Technology. This unit also includes an air switch for safe operation and is suitable for most kitchen sinks and maintained septic tanks. Includes a factory fitted power cord.
